pin.longFormSummary:
A budget hotel and hostel hybrid in western Cologne, with private family rooms, a shared guest kitchen, laundry and social spaces.

Family and budget stay

Choose a whole private family room and confirm its beds, occupancy and cot requirements. Shared dormitory beds are a separate booking product. The guest kitchen, laundry and social spaces can help families manage meals and longer stays; check charges, equipment and house rules.

The hotel is in the western Braunsfeld area, outside the historic city centre. Plan public transport and walking with luggage or children. Compare the full private-room price, breakfast, taxes, parking, storage and cancellation conditions for the actual travel dates.

Guest feedback

A firsthand student-group account describes clean, functional rooms, a quiet position at the end of a corridor, breakfast and nearby public transport. These are individual experiences rather than guarantees for every room. The guest-score snapshot has 83 reviews, so check recent feedback and the exact room layout before booking.

Opening and inventory

MEININGER opened this property on 22 September 2023. The opening report explicitly dates the start of operations that day; later press coverage is not a second opening.

The current operator portfolio lists 209 rooms and 750 beds. This is the portfolio inventory at research time, rather than a separately verified opening-day count.

The hotel forms part of the OVUM mixed-use development. No hotel-specific construction investment was verified; a budget for the wider development should not be treated as this hotel’s cost.

pin.longFormSummary:
A family resort in Concord, North Carolina, with suites, overnight indoor water-park access, daily family activities and additional paid attractions.

Family water-park stay

Confirm the exact suite layout, beds and booked occupancy. Overnight stays include indoor water-park admission and daily family activities; check hours, height restrictions, wristbands, supervision and arrival-day or departure-day access. MagiQuest, arcade games and other paid attractions have separate terms.

Compare the full stay cost, including parking, dining, taxes, attraction passes and package conditions. The outdoor pool and other outdoor activities depend on season, weather and operating calendars. The resort is in Concord, rather than downtown Charlotte.

Guest feedback

A September 2026 family account describes a clean, spacious suite, helpful staff and enjoyable water-park time, while noting a check-in queue, paid parking and expensive resort dining. A November guest separately reports insects in dining and shopping areas and concerns about sofa-bed bedding; that guest also describes apologies, a meal adjustment and a breakfast refund. These are individual guest reports, and experiences differ. Review recent feedback and confirm the booked suite and full bill.

Formal opening and inventory

The community opening celebration took place on 23 April 2009, according to local attendees writing the next morning.

The operator’s May 2009 results release says the resort had already opened at the end of the first quarter, then held its community grand-opening event in late April. The ceremony date therefore differs from the start of guest operations.

The current operator profile lists 402 suites and an 80,000-square-foot indoor water park, and records a 2019 renovation. These current descriptions are kept separate from early promotional room counts.

hotel.basis: Read 2026-11-22: Tripadvisor UK snapshot 5,397 reviews, overall 4.2/5. Rooms 4.3, Service 4.4, Location 4.6, Cleanliness 4.4, Value 3.8 rounded to half steps. Victoria C firsthand family review September 2026, exact day unknown. Positive stay and November insect/bedding complaint retained. AAA exact-address 402-unit resort verified. Forbes Charlotte no match; MICHELIN Concord unavailable, acclaim null.
